title: Dilations of cycles with the integer slice property have the integer slice property
statement: Hypothesis names: (REP), (MR), (SL) are the exact frozen statements of the DAG theorems cmc_exists_massRepresentation, cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_slice_mass_bounds (hypotheses of the selected parent cbr_cycle_isIntegerMultiplicity); (RU) is the exact frozen statement of the sibling cbr_setIntegral_eq_of_integral_eq, (CT) = (T1) ∧ (T2) ∧ (MM) that of cbr_measure_convergence_tools, (RECT) that of cbr_rectifiable_of_approx_tangent; whichever are needed appear verbatim as hypotheses of the Lean statement. In words: (REP) a current T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U open, with M_W(T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U has a mass representation (μ, ξ): μ(ℝ^P∖U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, μ(W) = M_W(T) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, and μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0 provided also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U; (MR) M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for an IMRep R of T in an open U and open W; (SL) for T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) with admissible representations (μ, ξ) of T and (μ', ξ') of ∂T and L-Lipschitz f there are currents A_t, B_t with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t = B_t on forms supported off {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0}h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h < f < t}) and ∫_a^b M_W(∂A_t − B_t)dt ≤ Lμ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for open W; (RU) an identity ∫ξ₁(ω)dμ₁ = ∫ξ₂(ω)dμ₂ + ∫ξ₃(ω)dμ₃ between admissible pairs, valid for all test forms on an open U, remains valid with all integrals restricted to any Borel set; (T1) measures μ_j with sup_jμ_j(K) < ∞ on compacts have a subsequence converging to a Radon μ (against C_c, limsup on compacts ≤ μ, liminf on open sets ≥ μ); (T2) if X_j ⇀ X with admissible representations (μ_j, ξ_j), (μ_X, ξ_X), limsup_jμ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) on compacts, f continuous and μ{f = t} = 0, then ∫_{f<t}ξ_j(ω)dμ_j → ∫_{f<t}ξ_X(ω)dμ_X; (MM) if Z_j(t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0}h⁻¹μ_j(G ∩ {t−h < f < t}) on (a, b) then some measurable g ≥ liminf_jZ_j a.e. on (a, b) has ∫_a^b g ≤ L·liminf_jμ_j(G ∩ {a < f < b}); (RECT) a Borel M with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ having approximate tangent spaces Q(x) at Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M with x ↦ p_{Q(x)} Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable is countably n-rectifiable. Notation: Hⁿ = μHE[n], ω_n = unitBallVolume n, |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α for covectors, admissible representation (μ, ξ) of a current X in ℝ^P: μ Borel, finite on compact sets, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e., X(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x))dμ(x) for every test form. ISP (integer slice property) of Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P): for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of Y and (μ', ξ') of ∂Y and every Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, for L¹-a.e. t, all A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms have ∂A − B integer multiplicity. For a ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0 let η(y) := dilation a λ y = λ⁻¹(y − a); X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) is called a dilation of X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) if X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all test m-forms ω, ω' on ℝ^P with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. Assume (SL) and (RU). Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d+1, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and X, X' ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with X' a dilation of X. Suppose ∂X = 0 and X has an admissible representation (μ_X, ξ_X) (μ_X finite on compact sets, ξ_X μ_X-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ_X(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ_X-a.e. x and all α, X(ω) = ∫ξ_X(ω)dμ_X for all ω). If X has ISP, then X' has ISP.
